knowledge_gaps: The baseline masking policy and terminal-example frequency are unspecified, so the proposed change and its incremental novelty cannot be established.

Reproduction requires the target-index distribution, user/window sampling, interior mask rate, handling of histories shorter than two items, and guarantee of at least one supervised position. Uniform historical-prefix sampling does not inherently emphasize recent preferences.

A 1:1 batch mixture changes both context availability and the number of supervised targets per optimizer step. Averaging each batch loss does not equalize supervision volume, so attribution needs explicit controls.

The simulator feedback does not establish that masking mismatch causes stale recommendations or compatibility errors. Potential 7/10 and difficulty 2/10 are provisional judgments; diagnostic and sampler changes may increase implementation effort.

No baseline validation HR@10, checkpoint-selection schedule, or GPU-budget allocation is supplied. Training margins cannot establish generalization, and repeated selection on 200 validation users per category risks validation overfitting.

follow_up_queries.reason: Clarify prior art and define the actual masking intervention before assigning novelty or expected benefit.
